tenderSchedule.title: Selection of Solar Power Generators (SPGs) on the basis of Build, Own & Operate (BOO) for solar power plants through RESCO mode, under Non-CFA category for 25 years under CM-SKY scheme (Mukya Mantri Soura Krishi Yojane).
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of Solar Power Generators (SPGs) on the basis of Build, Own & Operate (BOO) for Design, Survey, Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning, Operation & Maintenance of grid connected distributed solar power plants for solarization of Sub-Station (SS) of capacity 100MW in CESC jurisdiction, its associated 11kV line to connect the plant with concerned SS and Remote Monitoring System (RMS) of solar power plants through RESCO mode, under Non-CFA category for 25 years under CM-SKY (Mukhya Mantri Soura Krishi Yojane) Scheme
tenderSchedule.locationName: CESCOM Superintending Engineer IT Corporate Office Mysuru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of GM IT, No.29, CESC Corporate Office, Hinkal, Vijayanagara 2nd stage

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be Blacklisted/ Defaulted against any work/service against any of the previous orders placed by any State/Central Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Private Sector as on the date of submission of bid. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement. Undertaking by authorized signatory with name and seal as per Annexure-X. In case of Consortium, all the members must submit the undertaking as per Annexure-X.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.5 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be acted in concert or in collusion with any other Bidder or other person(s) and also not done any act, deed or thing which is or could be regarded as anti-competitive.In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement.Undertaking for Anti-Collusion by authorized signatory with name and seal as per Annexure-XI.In case of Consortium, all the members must submit the undertaking as per Annexure-XI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.6 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder can be a single business entity, Government Owned entity OR, Consortium of up to Three (3) members, with one of the member as a Lead Bidder.In case of Consortium, Joint Bidding Agreement as per Annexure-XVI.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.1 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following a)Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment theretoa) LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment theretoa)Firm registered/unregistered under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d)Firm registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860/The Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 in India a)Sole Proprietor incorporated in India.Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with MOA and AOA OR Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008 OR a.Partnership Deed in case of partnership firm & GST Registration Certificate b.Certificate issued by Directorate of Industries & Commerce, if applicable c.Shops & Establishment Registration Certificate, if applicable OR The Certificate issued by the Registrar of Society as per Societies Act, 1860/1960 OR The Registration Certificate issued by Statutory Authority OR PAN & GST Registration Certificate Shops & Establishment Registration Certificate, if applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.2 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should submit a Power of Attorney (POA) authorizing a person to sign the documents on behalf of the Bidder, submit technical, commercial information and attend meetings on behalf of the Bidder.Sole Bidder to upload POA as per Annexure-XIV.In case of Consortium, POA for lead member as per Annexure-XV alongwith supporting BoD resolution passed in favour of the Lead Member.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.7 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the competent authority.a)Registration certificate issued by the competent authority for Clause 5.4.b)Self-declaration certificate in the prescribed format as per the Annexure-XXI (A), (B), (C), as applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevent documents shall be uploaded as per clause 5.1.8 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have positive Minimum net worth of INR 96 lakhs per MW as on 31st March 2025. In case of Consortium, all the partners shall collectively meet this financial criterion.Ex If the net worth of a Bidder is INR 960 Lakhs as on 31st March 2025, then the bidder is eligible to quote for Projects covering upto maximum of 10MW capacity only. 1. Certificate fulfilling required financial criteria in the name of Bidder duly certified by Practicing Chartered Accountant as per the format provided in Annexure-V & Annexure-V(A) duly mentioning UDIN. 2.Firms Annual Audited Balance sheet and Profit & Loss statement for FY 2024-25. The Newly established firms in existence for one year, shall upload the latest audited financial statements

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- relevent documents as per clause 5.2.2 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should engage Electrical Contractor having license of minimum Class-1 grade for Electrical works in Karnataka or any other State.Undertaking regarding engaging minimum Class-1 Electrical Contractor as per Annexure-IX

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.4 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall propose commercially established technology only and at least one project not less than 1MW capacity based on this technology is successfully operational for at least one year.Undertaking for Technical Capacity (Technology) as per the Format provided in Annexure-IV.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.2.1 of RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must have the required GST Registration. In case of Consortium, all the members must fulfill this requirement.Copy of GST registration certificate(s) with legible GSTIN.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document shall be uploaded as per Clause 5.1.3 of RFP
